n722d12eeb2.headline: Ukraine officials come under shelling attack on front as invasion fears rise
n722d12eeb2.summary: US President Joe Biden said he is convinced Russian leader Vladimir Putin has decided to invade Ukraine, as Ukrainian officers came under shelling on the front.
n722d12eeb2.why: Russia is a major global energy and commodity exporter, so escalation of its conflict with Ukraine affects energy prices, sanctions risk and global markets.
n722d12eeb2.why_moved: A US statement that Putin has decided to invade and reports of shelling on the front raised expectations of military escalation and sanctions.
